$comment: Section 12 conformance matrix of the Originals Protocol, one entry per row, pinned to originals-spec a3ffdc1, the head of open PR 59 (carried logs and EVM anchoring, experimental), which sits on master 915b726 (#58 merged); it is not master. Rows 193 to 285 were #58's additions and rows 286 to 300 PR 59's at 3ed0f89 (ids C12-200 to C12-307); PR 59 rewords C12-23 and C12-188, and at a3ffdc1 rewords C12-150, C12-201, C12-210, C12-218, C12-222, C12-227, C12-249, C12-252, C12-260, C12-273, C12-278 and C12-289 and adds 24 rows, C12-308 to C12-331, so the table has 324 rows. Each row is covered by a test that references its id, or stays status=todo. status=partial means some layers are tested and the note says what remains; coveredBy lists the citing test files (checked by packages/vh/tests/conformance/registry.test.ts). Phases follow spec section 10 and plans/011; phase 5 is section 10's step 6 (EVM anchoring), which plans/011 does not yet schedule (PROVISIONAL). status=not-applicable means an owner decision makes the row moot pending a spec edit; its note names the decision. Ids are stable across re-pins: position is the row's place in the pinned table. Pinned rows are in table order, positions 1 to N; rows from open pull requests follow them, and two pull requests can each propose a row at the same position. A proposal can also insert rows between pinned ones, and reword pinned rows, whose note then gives the proposed wording. A row with `proposal` is not in the pinned table: it comes from the named open spec pull request, is implemented provisionally, and its position is its place in that pull request's table. A row the pinned table no longer has is listed under `retired` with the commit and reason; its id is never reused, and no test cites it.

rows.requiredResult: Allowed, as for any accepted checkpoint (P7.16, P7.15)
rows.note: Exercised with a Bitcoin inscription's metadata and body (packages/vh/tests/carried.test.ts) and, through the SDK, with an Original's publication record on an EVM token at its finalized block (packages/sdk/tests/unit/originals/evm-sdk.test.ts, EXPERIMENTAL).

rows.test: Writer about to write a carrier for a log with an `anchor` member
rows.requiredResult: User told that the file discloses the chain and the minter’s address (P7.15)

rows.test: Entry published on an Original’s token, whose did:vh or did:webvh signer later removes the signing key
rows.requiredResult: Remains current, as for an inscribed entry; not reported as historically authorized only, and its ordering not labelled claimed (P7.6, P7.9, P9.20)

rows.test: Fork of an Original with an EVM `anchor`, then an anchoring entry accepted on its token
rows.requiredResult: Settled by that anchor’s branch, under the chain’s finality and trust class; on a `consortium` or `operator` chain the settlement is described as attested, never as proven (P6.6, P9.20, P9.24, P9.27)

rows.test: Move entry’s signing key removed, or its signer DID deactivated, after the departure and before the arrival
rows.requiredResult: Arrival accepted; the move entry’s signer is checked at the departure only (P9.29)

rows.test: Move entry published as a departure when its signing key is not valid at the departure’s inscription time
rows.requiredResult: Rejected; not departed (P9.15, P9.29)

rows.test: Complete evidence package of an anchored Original, read without access to the anchor
rows.requiredResult: Missing evidence; at most the entries before the first anchoring entry reported; the package not preferred to the anchor (P7.1, P7.14)

rows.test: Complete evidence package of an Original with a did:btco signer, read offline
rows.requiredResult: That signer’s history is not in the package; identity evidence incomplete until it is read from Bitcoin (P7.1, P14.10, P5.6)

rows.test: `aliases` holding a DID of any other method, or the same DID twice
rows.requiredResult: Rejected (P14.5)

rows.test: Grant naming the Original’s did:webvh alias or its token alias
rows.requiredResult: Rejected (P5.15)

rows.test: Original that moved to Bitcoin grants a did:btco editor in or after the move entry
rows.requiredResult: Accepted; the same grant in an entry carrying an `anchor` member is rejected (P9.26)

rows.test: Signer asked to sign input that is not a well-formed Originals entry, or without showing the signer, the Original, the operation and the resource changes
rows.requiredResult: Refused (P5.11)

rows.test: Exact-checkpoint resolution of a checkpoint the resolver cannot supply
rows.requiredResult: Reports why; the latest checkpoint is not substituted (P3.2)

rows.test: Report for an anchored Original
rows.requiredResult: States the confirmation depth relied on and whether more than one independent index agreed on the sat’s location (P9.5, P9.11)

rows.test: Genesis parameters other than exactly `method` and `scid`; a later entry with a non-empty parameters object that is not a deactivation; a null parameter value
rows.requiredResult: Rejected (P14.1)

rows.test: Plaintext metadata, base64 content or raw storage
rows.requiredResult: Never labelled encrypted (P8.2)

rows.test: Carried file imported, then read again with no separate opt-in to resolve
rows.requiredResult: No resolver request; the import is not an opt-in (P7.13)

rows.test: Carried checkpoint from before the anchoring entry of an Original that is now anchored
rows.requiredResult: Allowed; reported as a historical checkpoint, valid as of it, with no statement about current anchoring (P7.14, P7.15)

rows.test: Carried file with a wrong or missing file name extension
rows.requiredResult: The extension is only a hint; the other carriers are tried, and the carrier found is checked against the verified descriptor’s `mediaType` (P14.14)

rows.test: Descriptor `mediaType` with a parameter, such as `text/plain; charset=utf-8`
rows.requiredResult: Rejected; the parameter is not ignored (P14.6, P14.14)

rows.test: Text block whose closer line is not directly preceded by the END marker, or whose BEGIN marker in a block comment is not directly preceded by the opener
rows.requiredResult: No carrier (P14.16)

rows.test: HTML version ending inside an open `script`, `style` or `textarea` element / inside an open `pre` element
rows.requiredResult: Writer refuses / writer accepts; the block parses as a separate comment (P14.16)

rows.test: Shell or C-family version whose last line ends in a line continuation
rows.requiredResult: Writer refuses (P14.16)

rows.test: did:evm DID resolved from token reads alone, the token’s first record being junk or another Original’s log
rows.requiredResult: Candidate taken from an anchoring or arrival publication, then verified with its link to the queried token; the junk record does not decide (P3.9)

rows.test: Token minted by anyone, with a `tokenURI` but no verified history
rows.requiredResult: Not shown to be an Original (P9.23)

rows.test: Provider that cannot serve state at the finalized block because finality trails its retained state
rows.requiredResult: Not usable for that read; missing evidence (P9.22)

rows.test: Provider read at its own, later finalized block, compared with the other provider at the lower block
rows.requiredResult: Not evidence for the comparison (P9.22)

rows.test: Verification repeated with no evidence of a finality failure
rows.requiredResult: Earlier finalized block hashes need not be read again; when evidence appears, a warning is reported and retained results resting on that block are discarded (P9.22)

rows.test: Token with many records, verifier holding a checkpoint
rows.requiredResult: MAY resume from the checkpoint and read only later records; no record cap or reader budget (P9.25)
rows.note: Also exercised against a contract on anvil: packages/sdk/tests/integration/evm-anvil.test.ts (gated on a local chain).

rows.test: Writer staging an upload
rows.requiredResult: Learns the upload ID from `UploadBegun`; the event is never evidence (P14.20)
rows.note: The writer's use of the event: packages/sdk/tests/unit/originals/evm-sdk.test.ts stages an upload through the SDK against a fake anchor contract, learns the upload ID from `UploadBegun` and reads the record back from state; the end-to-end staged upload is in packages/sdk/tests/integration/evm-anvil.test.ts (gated on a local chain). Contract behavior is tested in Solidity: contracts/test/OriginalsAnchor.t.sol test_uploadBegunEvent (forge test; outside the Bun roots this registry scans, and not run in CI), citing C12-329.

rows.test: Move entry prepared before any departure record exists
rows.requiredResult: Layers judged provisionally by the current classes; by the classes at the departure record’s timestamp once it is read (P9.28)

rows.test: Signed anchoring entry not published, genesis `anchor` member alone, or token minted with no publication
rows.requiredResult: Not anchored (P9.19, P9.23)

rows.test: Two entries whose `versionTime` values differ by less than one millisecond, or a `versionTime` with more than three fractional digits
rows.requiredResult: Rejected (P14.2)
